top_choice_rationale: P002 rewards a clean prediction-then-discovery sequence: the Bistritzer-MacDonald flat-band magic angle, followed by correlated insulating and superconducting states observed at that angle, independently reproduced and carried into other graphene multilayers and moire TMD systems, so it is a new platform for correlated quantum matter. The citation can stay silent on the pairing mechanism, as the cuprates were honoured before theirs was understood. I accept that credit is imperfect (Cao and other experimental groups, earlier continuum-model work) and that the field is only eight years old, and I rank the mature, quantitatively cross-checked lattice clock P001 a close second, with its overlap with the 2005 and 2012 prizes the main reservation. An award of either is preferable to no award.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; no collaboration with MacDonald, Jarillo-Herrero, Bistritzer, Katori or Ye. Chaired the 2025 prize on superconducting-circuit tunnelling, which is not on this slate.
